verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents a Postgres endpoint aimed at "BI tools, any Postgres client" with no DuckDB install needed. It also lists official drivers and SDKs, including Java. Together these suggest dashboards can connect over standard Postgres-compatible drivers without custom glue. However, the pack never explicitly names JDBC or ODBC drivers or any specific documented BI-tool integration guide, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit JDBC/ODBC driver documentation, named BI-tool integration guides (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker), independent confirmation that dashboards connect cleanly.
